scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix desktop && npm install --prefix cloud-backend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix desktop" "npm run dev --prefix cloud-backend"
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend:desktop && cd desktop && npm run build
scripts.build:cloud: npm run build:cloud-backend && npm run build:frontend:cloud
